title: retry_net resends only safe methods on a 5xx reply
why: Lane merge-net-small-fixes 14:33 CST Nov 12: retry_net resends any method on a 5xx reply; a PUT merge went 4 times.
note: Fix in merge/merge.py retry_net: retry GET only (or a PUT/POST only when the call is idempotent by design); read the last -X, not the first. Red first on the 4-times PUT merge. Measured: PUT merge 1 call on this head, 4 on main. Sentence rewritten in place, marked owner ruling pending. Owner item 650 (retry-once-unsafe-methods); the merge waits on it. Not blocking: the lock-release DELETE loses its retry; the lock comment already says no late retry, left as is. A fix round (tests, idempotent mark on set_body, more -X forms) comes on #2964.
